name: OLA ELECTRIC MOBILITY LTD
summary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited develops, manufactures, and sells electric vehicles in India. It operates through the Automotive and Cell segments. The company provides electric scooters; and electric vehicle components, such as battery packs, motors and vehicle frames, and cells. It also offers charging solutions, as well as operates service centers. Ola Electric Mobility Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
